tools.name: search_games
tools.description: Search for PC games across Steam, GOG, Humble Bundle, IndieGala, Gamesplanet, Fanatical, and GameBillet to find exact titles, relevance scores, and store availability.

tools.name: compare_prices
tools.description: Compare prices for a game by region. Returns cheapest store, sorted offers, and links to support developer (direct purchase).

tools.name: get_game
tools.description: Get a PC game's catalogue entry without checking live prices: its Game ID, Foxfind page, and each product (base game, editions, DLC) with the stores that list it. Use compare_prices for current prices.

tools.name: find_deals
tools.description: Find discounted games by discount, optionally under a maximum price. Confirm price with compare_prices before asserting.
